recommendation: Keep the commit as-is because it completes the narrow FHIR-38998 clarification on the active version management source page without changing broader FHIR versioning policy or unrelated canonical-version guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-38998 was Published/Persuasive for R5 by FHIR-I and requested a note in the label section that FHIR version labels are not SemVer compliant; specifically, SemVer precedence rules cannot be applied and labels are only sortable relative to labels with the same base.
initial_application: Git commit 29b2f1596afb0a22642e6ac1727659395f94b985 originally applied FHIR-38998 by adding the same-label-base sorting sentence to source/versions.html, and d1399f74f158a7e810db07f8f79052c9b3ecd721 escaped the less-than sign. The current source retained that sentence but did not explicitly state that FHIR labels are not SemVer pre-release labels or that SemVer precedence rules do not apply.
additional_context: Related versioning work FHIR-35168 and FHIR-35172 established and cleaned up the current major.minor.patch-label table. source/hierarchy.xml includes versions.html as the Change Management and Versioning page, confirming build scope. FHIR-I minutes for 2022-10-24 corroborate the FHIR-38998 persuasive vote, and exact Zulip issue-key search found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Updated source/versions.html in the label row to say that FHIR labels are not SemVer pre-release labels and that SemVer precedence rules do not apply, while preserving the existing same-label-base sorting guidance.
source_changes: source/versions.html: clarified the label bullet to state that FHIR labels are not SemVer pre-release labels and SemVer precedence rules do not apply, before the existing same-label-base sorting rule.

related_jiras.note: Established the current major.minor.patch-label terminology that FHIR-38998 clarifies.
Broader version management cleanup on the same page; it did not supersede the label-specific SemVer clarification.
